pqc_kit.name: Quantum Future: Client Data Safety Checklist for Small Business
pqc_kit.description:
**Is your client data safe in the quantum future?**

New computers are being built right now that could break today's internet security by 2030–2035. This means client records your business stores TODAY could be exposed TOMORROW.

This checklist was built for small business owners — dental offices, law firms, medical practices, accountants — who need plain-English guidance, not technical jargon.

**What's inside:**
✅ The 5-Step Client Data Safety Checklist (ready to hand to your IT person)
✅ Plain-English explanation of NPPI risk in the quantum future
✅ Regulatory compliance overview (HIPAA, GLBA, state privacy laws)
✅ 3 concrete actions you can take this week
✅ 6-term glossary your IT team will actually use
✅ Free NIST government resources

**This is NOT for:**
❌ Developers or IT professionals (they already know this)
❌ Enterprise companies (they have consultants charging $15,000+ for this)

**This IS for:**
✅ The business owner who just read about quantum computing and doesn't know what to do
✅ Practice managers who need to brief their board
✅ Any SMB that stores client records digitally

Based entirely on publicly available standards from the US National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST). Educational content — not legal or security advice.

*By TrustChain Services — trustchainservices.com/quantum-readiness*

literacy_guide.description:

Google, Microsoft, and Amazon are rebuilding their security infrastructure right now. The US government set a 2035 deadline. Bad actors are stealing encrypted client data TODAY — waiting for quantum computers to unlock it.

This guide is written for executives, not engineers.

**Built for:**
✅ CFOs and finance directors
✅ Healthcare executives (HIPAA compliance context included)
✅ Law firm partners
✅ Government contractors
✅ Any leader responsible for client data safety

**What you'll walk away with:**
✅ Clear explanation of "harvest now, decrypt later" in business terms
✅ Industry-specific risk breakdown (Healthcare, Finance, Legal, Government)
✅ 5 questions to ask your IT team this quarter
✅ 3-step business continuity plan for the quantum future
✅ Regulatory compliance overview across HIPAA, GLBA, SEC, state laws

**Why this exists:**
IBM and Deloitte charge $15,000–$50,000 for enterprise quantum assessments. Nobody was serving small and mid-sized businesses with affordable, plain-English guidance. This guide fills that gap.

Not legal or security advice. Educational content based on NIST public standards.
